title: Prove duplicate chase customers are refused across database pages
public_pr_body:
Add 2,002 customer records with matching names on pages one and three. Assert all three exact database ranges are read and that neither automatic nor fixed-recipient drafts are written when the later duplicate is discovered.

Validation: 63 customer matching/chase runner tests passed. No application change was necessary. Targets `chatgpt2/chase-customer-review-code-only`, the same base as #189.
